Ridge Regression (ℓ₂ Regularization) — Bias Correction of Numerical Prediction Model Temperature Forecast

Target: Next_Tmax (deg C) · Run UTC: 2026-11-24T18:44:22.325579+00:00

1. Dataset and Task Description

Summer next-day maximum temperature forecasts from Korea Meteorological Administration LDAPS across 25 Seoul weather stations (2013-2017).

  • Two trailing summary rows with missing Date/station (min/max rows in raw UCI CSV) and 27 rows with missing target 'Next_Tmax' are dropped prior to splitting.
  • 'Next_Tmin' is excluded as a co-target not available at prediction time; 'station' is excluded because station geography is captured by lat/lon/DEM/Slope.
  • Predictor missing values (~70-75 rows) are median-imputed using training-fold statistics only.
  • Chronological date-level 80/20 split ensures all stations on a given date appear together with zero same-day or future leakage.

3. Mathematical Methodology

Adds a squared \(\ell_2\) penalty on standardized slopes (leaving \(\beta_0\) unpenalized) to stabilize ill-conditioned \(\tilde{\mathbf{X}}^\top\tilde{\mathbf{X}}\) and reduce estimator variance.

$$\min_{\beta_0 \in \mathbb{R},\, \boldsymbol{\beta} \in \mathbb{R}^p} \|\mathbf{y} - \beta_0\mathbf{1} - \tilde{\mathbf{X}}\boldsymbol{\beta}\|_2^2 + \alpha\|\boldsymbol{\beta}\|_2^2, \qquad \hat{\boldsymbol{\beta}}_{\alpha} = (\tilde{\mathbf{X}}^\top \tilde{\mathbf{X}} + \alpha \mathbf{I}_p)^{-1}\tilde{\mathbf{X}}^\top \tilde{\mathbf{y}} \quad (\lambda \equiv \alpha \ge 0)$$

Implementation Note: min_{beta0, beta} ||y - beta0 - X*beta||_2^2 + alpha * ||beta||_2^2 (intercept beta0 unpenalized)
CV-Selected Hyperparameter: \(\alpha^* = 731.824\) (\(\lambda \equiv \alpha\)) over 60 grid points in \([0.0001, 1e+05]\).

7. Limitations and Conclusions

Facts & Interpretations

  • [Computed Fact] Held-out test performance (\(n_{\mathrm{test}} = 1538\)): \(R^2 = 0.6994\), \(\mathrm{RMSE} = 1.726\) deg C (Train \(R^2 = 0.7763\), Train \(\mathrm{RMSE} = 1.473\) deg C).
  • [Computed Fact] Largest standardized coefficients by magnitude: LDAPS_Tmax_lapse (+1.178), Present_Tmax (+0.4787), LDAPS_Tmin_lapse (+0.4769).
  • [Computed Fact] DateGroupedTimeSeriesSplit(5) selected \(\alpha^* = 731.8\) (CV RMSE = 1.717 deg C, CV \(R^2 = 0.6115\)), matching closed-form SVD within 4.93e-15.
  • [Interpretation] \(\ell_2\) regularization trades controlled bias for variance reduction, shrinking the standardized \(\ell_2\) norm from 2.127 (OLS) to 1.578 (ratio = 0.7422) and reducing effective degrees of freedom from \(p = 21\) to \(\operatorname{df}(\alpha^*) = 16.57\).
  • [Computed Fact] Adding \(\alpha^* \mathbf{I}_p\) stabilized the centered Gram condition number from \(\kappa(\tilde{\mathbf{X}}^\top\tilde{\mathbf{X}}) = 82.91\) to \(\kappa(\tilde{\mathbf{X}}^\top\tilde{\mathbf{X}} + \alpha^*\mathbf{I}_p) = 29.12\).

Assumptions & Limitations

  • [No Feature Elimination] Ridge shrinks coefficients smoothly toward zero via \(\ell_2\) regularization and never sets coefficients exactly to zero; all \(p\) predictors remain active.
  • [Heteroskedasticity / Nonlinearity] Spearman \(r_s(|\mathbf{e}|, \hat{\mathbf{y}}) = -0.146\) (\(p = 6.11e-31\)).
  • [Temporal Structure] Static linear predictors omit explicit lag or seasonal terms across the chronological train-to-test boundary.
  • [Linearity Assumption] Linear models assume additive linear relationships between standardized predictors and conditional target expectation.
